text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos met with the U.N.'s special representative to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye. The two spoke about Angola's peace process. Dos Santos also met with UNITA represenative Isaias Samakuva, who was carrying a message from UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi.

- The National assembly begins its third and last day on an extraordinary session and will vote at the end of the day on a resolution that would condemn UNITA for increased military activity that is in danger of taking the country back to war.
- The French Secretary of State for Cooperation, Charles Josselin, will visit Angola between July 28-29.
